description: Marvuros wears a dark muted burgundy long open-front coat over a cream linen knee-length tunic. Narrow gold geometric woven borders edge the coat opening, hem and cuffs, with small circular decorative clasps near the upper front. The under-tunic has matching neckline and hem trim. A decorated brown belt with round gold-toned fittings and a long hanging end secures the waist. Cream trousers and tall brown leather boots finish the outfit. His arms rest naturally behind his back, so hands are obscured rather than visibly cropped. There is no headgear, armor, weapon or crown.
